field.label: Accept Ookla terms
field.help: Required. The Ookla Speedtest CLI needs you to accept the Ookla EULA, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy (https://www.speedtest.net/about/eula). No test runs until this is ticked.

field.label: Show 30-day averages
field.help: Untick to show only the last result, on both the Results page and the dashboard widget.

field.label: Scheduled tests
field.help: Run a test automatically on a schedule.

field.label: Interval (hours)
field.help: 1-23, or 24 for daily. Values that do not divide 24 give uneven spacing at midnight.

field.label: Server ID
field.help: Leave empty to let Speedtest pick the closest server. Use "Find servers" below.

field.label: Bind to interface
field.help: Force the test out of one interface (e.g. a specific WAN). Empty uses the default route.
